payload.message:
JIRA sprint task allocation. Each agent chooses at most one micro-task (or skips). Maximize tasks completed, prefer higher-priority tasks, then minimize total cost. Avoid duplicate task selections and infeasible assignments.

NOTE: If environment.assignment_filling=true and an agent fails to assign a variable, the environment will fill any remaining unassigned variables with a uniform-random allowed assignment when producing final results.

This blackboard is a private communication channel.
Participants: Armanda, Augustina, Francesco, Jenise, Lennie, Zelda

payload.content: Planning: I (Lennie) will likely claim one low-priority frontend micro-task, leaning toward lowest cost feasible (ISSUE-0001::triage cost 1.82) or review/docs if unclaimed. Please avoid assigning duplicates.

Augustina (planning): I’m considering claiming ISSUE-0001::triage (effort 1.6, low, cost 2.01) or another low frontend micro-task. I will avoid duplicates with Lennie—please confirm what you intend to pick.

Augustina (planning): My skill fit is strongest for machine-learning and frontend; among available tasks I see ISSUE-0001::triage as cheapest feasible for frontend. If Lennie claims triage, I’ll take the next-lowest-cost frontend item (docs/review) that stays within my 4h availability.

Armanda planning (iter1): I have strongest ML skill but all current tasks are low priority. Cheapest feasible for me on tag alignment/cost seems ISSUE-0002::review (cost 6.90, effort 3.0) within 8h, or lower-cost options if left. I’m not taking ISSUE-0001::triage if others do it—please coordinate to avoid duplicates.

Can you confirm whether you (Lennie/Augustina/others) are taking ISSUE-0002 tasks (review/test/implement) or only ISSUE-0001 frontend? I plan to claim at most one: likely ISSUE-0002::review if unclaimed.

Francesco planning: best fit is mobile-development with ML skill, but my cheapest feasible there is ISSUE-0002::review (effort 3.0, cost 3.06) within 10h. I will avoid ISSUE-0001 triage/docs/test (very high cost for me). Please confirm if anyone else plans ISSUE-0002::review so we don’t duplicate.
If ISSUE-0002::review is unclaimed, I will take it in execution. Otherwise I’ll skip (to avoid duplicate) since remaining ISSUE-0002 micro-tasks (test/implement) are higher cost for me.

Jenise planning: with ML skill, my cheapest feasible is ISSUE-0002::review (cost 6.09, effort 3.0). I will claim ISSUE-0002::review unless someone else already does; otherwise I’ll take a low frontend micro-task (likely ISSUE-0001::review/cost 20) but prefer ISSUE-0002::review to minimize cost.
